[[File:RYLL.png|thumb|right|200px|Ryll]]
{{Quote|Ryll is a highly addictive spice.|[[Lon Cope]]|<ref name="SWG:CCFRSM">{{SWGcite|exp=NGE|type=class|Legacy|CorSec Case Files: Ryll Smuggling Ring|Corellia}}</ref>}}
'''Ryll''' was a relatively weak form of [[Spice/Legends|spice]] used to create a number of medicines used throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]]. 

==Properties==
Ryll had medicinal properties especially as a painkiller, also causing euphoria and hallucinations, ranging from interesting to disturbing. As such, it was used to create different variants of hallucinogens and other intoxicants.<ref name="guide" />

It could be combined with [[Glitterstim/Legends|glitterstim]] to create [[glitteryll]]. [[Ryll kor]] was another type of ryll, used primarily for medical purposes.

==History==
Ryll was discovered around [[4800 BBY]] and mined on the planet [[Ryloth/Legends|Ryloth]], although it was presumably found on other planets such as [[Naos III/Legends|Naos III]]. 

Although production on Ryloth was legal<ref name="guide">''[[Shadows of the Empire Planets Guide]]''</ref> it was also smuggled into the [[Corporate Sector/Legends|Corporate Sector]] for illegal sale to the workers. As with many substances used for illegal recreation, ryll had the potential to be very addictive and dangerous. In addition to the mining operations on Ryloth, just before the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]] used slaves from a false religion to produce the spice on the planet [[Ylesia/Legends|Ylesia]] until the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] involved themselves with the operations and ultimately shut down the planet's spice ring.

Most of the exported spice avoided the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]] but traveled through the [[Death Wind Corridor/Legends|Death Wind Corridor]], which linked Ryloth to [[Roon/Legends|Roon]] (through [[Cloak of the Sith/Legends|The Cloak of the Sith]]).<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

Both the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] placed restrictions on ryll's use, licensing it only to pharmaceutical companies for the production of painkillers and anesthetics.

In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]] the variety of [[Ryll kor]] was used for the cure of the [[Krytos virus]], which made Ryloth of galactic importance.<ref name="TEA" />
